item.title: Bands used to ‘break’ on Letterman — now they’re recreating late night on YouTube
item.summary: When CBS ended “The Late Show With Stephen Colbert” earlier this year, it also shuttered the program’s robust music offerings — a major blow for artists whose television platform was already dwindling.
